title: Imagick PHP extension heap overflow in versions before 3.7.0
summary: A heap overflow was reported in the Imagick PHP extension before 3.7.0 when processing crafted images. Applications that do not load ext-imagick are outside the affected component.
remediation: If Imagick is present, upgrade ext-imagick to 3.7.0 or later. If the extension is not installed or required, no change is needed.
